description: The three 10-bit TMDS lane words per pixel clock for HDMI or DVI, which the hdmi_out cores serialise. HDMI = 0: DVI (three tmds_encoders). HDMI = 1: HDMI 1.4 with the video preamble and guard band, a data island in each line's blanking (TERC4, BCH error correction) with Audio Clock Regeneration, 48 kHz stereo 16-bit audio samples (audio_ready asks for each pair), and the AVI and Audio InfoFrames.

de.description: Die drei 10-Bit-TMDS-Wörter je Pixeltakt für HDMI oder DVI, die die hdmi_out-Kerne serialisieren. HDMI = 0: DVI (drei tmds_encoder). HDMI = 1: HDMI 1.4 mit Video-Präambel und Guard Band, einer Data Island in der Austastlücke jeder Zeile (TERC4, BCH-Fehlerkorrektur) mit Audio Clock Regeneration, 48-kHz-Stereo-Samples zu 16 Bit (audio_ready fordert jedes Paar an) und den AVI- und Audio-InfoFrames.
de.name: HDMI/DVI-Encoder

name: HDMI/DVI encoder

parameters.description: 1: HDMI with audio and InfoFrames; 0: DVI
parameters.name: HDMI

parameters.description: The pixel clock in Hz (HDMI's audio clock: CTS = PIXEL_HZ / 1000)
parameters.name: PIXEL_HZ

parameters.description: CEA-861 video code for the AVI InfoFrame (1 = 640x480, 4 = 720p60, 16 = 1080p60)
parameters.name: VIC

parameters.description: Picture aspect for the AVI InfoFrame (1 = 4:3, 2 = 16:9)
parameters.name: ASPECT

ports.description: HDMI = 1: the left sample (signed), taken while audio_ready is high
ports.name: audio_l

ports.description: Pulses at 48 kHz once islands run; the pair on audio_l/audio_r is taken in that clock
ports.name: audio_ready
